SELECT p.id AS payment_id, p.appointment_id, p.order_no, p.amount, p.status, p.pay_time, DATE_ADD(a.create_time, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS expires_at FROM payment p INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = p.appointment_id WHERE p.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND a.patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment a INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.appointment_id = a.id SET a.status = '取消', s.remain_count = s.remain_count + 1, p.status = CASE WHEN p.status = '待支付' THEN '已关闭' ELSE p.status END WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND a.status = '待支付' AND a.create_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM appointment a WHERE a.status = '待支付' AND a.create_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) ORDER BY a.source_id, a.id
